description:
Reset the accumulated **manual-recording** dimension for a branch.

Manual uploads are **additive**: each ``upload_local_coverage`` with
``coverage_kind="manual"`` unions that hand-driven session into the
branch's manual dimension, so you can build a pass up one flow at a
time. Call this to wipe that accumulation and start over — every
function goes back to Unexercised. The branch's ``manual_languages`` are
kept, so the Manual Recording view stays visible; only the per-function
coverage is cleared.

This does **not** touch browser coverage (``coverage_kind="browser"``),
which has no clear at all: every producer there replaces its own
contribution on its next run, so nothing accumulates to be reset.

``repository`` is the GitHub 'owner/repo' (a repo UUID also works);
``branch`` defaults to the repository's default branch. Errors when the
branch has no local analysis to clear. Returns ``cleared_functions`` —
the number of function rows reset.
name: clear_manual_coverage
